## Conclusion

$MSTR is not a fee-free Bitcoin ETF. It adds leverage, equity dilution, financing risk, a software business, and a shifting premium or discount to Bitcoin holdings. That can amplify both gains and losses.

An “all-in” comparison is not ETF fees versus no fees; it is direct BTC exposure versus a leveraged, actively financed corporate equity. Debt maturities, holder puts, collateral, and covenants remain necessary inputs for a firmer distress assessment.

This is research, not investment advice.
